letter_deductions.deduction: Less: Registration charges - List IV (part of cost of treatment)
Less: Modern treatment limit, balance available 70,000.00
letter_deductions.why: Cl. 4.6 limit is 1,00,000; a 70,000 balance implies 30,000 used earlier this year under cl. 4.6, which no document shows; on the documents the cut is 1,41,200 - 1,00,000 = 41,200.
5% of admissible (cl. 9.3); method right, amount follows the sub-limit balance (5% of 70,000 if the insurer's balance is right, 5% of 1,00,000 on the documents).

notes: Cl. 4.6 sub-limit read as applying to the whole hospitalisation claim for that procedure (admissible capped before co-pay, DECISIONS 3). The settlement depends on the insurer's statement that only 70,000 of the 1,00,000 cl. 4.6 limit remains; no earlier claim is documented, so this cannot be checked. On the documents the payable is 95,000 (1,00,000 less 5% co-pay); if the insurer's 70,000 balance is substantiated, its 66,500 is correct. The policyholder should ask for the earlier claim details. No sum-insured issue: SI 2,00,000 with no documented earlier use.
